1900.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: I'm looking forward to ____ you.

1901.translation: For look forward to, to na preposition, so gerund dey come after am.

1902.translation: After this to, use di -ing form, no be base verb.

1903.translation: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

1904.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: They finished ____ the project.

1907.translation: Di grammar for this sentence correct? I enjoy to swim.

1910.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: She hopes ____ abroad next year.

1913.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: The window ____ by Tom.

1914.translation: Passive na be verb + past participle (+ by di person wey do di action). Di be verb dey show di tense.

1917.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: English ____ in many countries.

1918.translation: English na wetin people dey speak, and na general fact for today.

1920.translation: Passive verb na be + past participle. Di past participle of send na sent.

1921.translation: Find di sentence wey use base form where past participle suppose dey.

1922.translation: E suppose be was sent, no be was send .

1923.translation: Choose di words wey fit di blank for di conversation. A: Who painted this picture? B: It ____ by Picasso.

1924.translation: Na di picture dem paint. Di painter dey come after by.

1925.translation: E happen for past, so was painted.

1926.translation: Change di active sentence to passive and fill di blank. Mina cleans the room. → The room ____ by Mina.

1927.translation: Di object the room become subject, and cleans change to is cleaned .

1928.translation: Na present tense, so is + cleaned .

1929.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: This bridge ____ in 1990.

1932.translation: Change di active sentence to passive and fill di blank. They made this chair. → This chair ____ by them.

1933.translation: made na past, so di passive too na past.

1935.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: The song ____ by millions of people.

1936.translation: Na di song people dey love.

1938.translation: Di grammar for this sentence correct? The door was open by the wind.

1940.translation: E suppose be was opened by the wind .

1941.translation: Write di verb for brackets for di correct form. These letters ____ by my grandfather. (write)

1942.translation: letters na plural, and di action happen for past.

1944.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: She ____ never eaten sushi.

1945.translation: Present perfect na have/has + past participle. Use since with starting point and for with how long something last.

1946.translation: Di subject na She, so use has + eaten (present perfect).

1947.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: I have studied English ____ three years.

1948.translation: three years dey show how long something last.

1949.translation: Use for before how long something last (three years).

1950.translation: Clear past time expressions like yesterday and ago no dey go with present perfect.

1951.translation: Check di time expressions for each sentence.

1952.translation: yesterday na past time, so use went, no be has gone.

1953.translation: Choose di words wey fit di blank for di conversation. A: Have you ever been to Jeju? B: Yes, I have ____ there twice.

1954.translation: 'Visit and come back' na have been to; 'leave go there and no dey here now' na have gone to.

1955.translation: B dey talk about visit to Jeju two times.

1956.translation: Na experience, so have been correct.

1957.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Jisu moved to Daegu in 2021. It is 2026 now." Question: How long Jisu don live for Daegu?

1958.translation: First find how long: 2026 − 2021 = 5 . Then choose for / since .

1959.translation: Na 5 years, so For five years. correct.

1960.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: They ____ just arrived.

1964.translation: With last summer, use visited (past form).

1965.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: We ____ lived here since 2018.

1967.translation: Di grammar for this sentence correct? I have seen him yesterday.

1968.translation: E use yesterday together with present perfect.

1969.translation: Use past form, like I saw him yesterday.

1970.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: He has ____ his homework already.

1971.translation: Past participle dey come after has.

1973.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Mina joined the school choir last month. She practices every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival. Mina is excited but also a little nervous." Question: When Mina dey practise?

1974.translation: Read di question first, then find di sentence for di passage wey give clue.

1975.translation: Find di sentence wey get practices .

1976.translation: Di second sentence talk say: every Tuesday and Thursday.

1977.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Mina joined the school choir last month. She practices every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival. Mina is excited but also a little nervous." Question: Wetin di choir go do next week?

1978.translation: Find di sentence wey get Next week .

1979.translation: Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival.

1980.translation: Read di passage and decide whether di sentence correct. "Mina joined the school choir last month. She practices every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival. Mina is excited but also a little nervous." Sentence: Mina feels only excited.

1981.translation: Check how Mina feel for di last sentence.

1982.translation: Mina excited but also a little nervous , so no be only excitement Mina dey feel.

1983.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Many students use their phones during class. This makes it hard to listen to the teacher. Some schools now ask students to keep their phones in a box until lunch. As a result, students talk more with each other." Question: Which title best fit di passage?

1984.translation: Good title dey cover di main idea for di whole passage.

1985.translation: Di main idea na di school new rule (phones inside box).

1986.translation: Di main idea na di new rule of keeping phones inside box.

1987.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Many students use their phones during class. This makes it hard to listen to the teacher. Some schools now ask students to keep their phones in a box until lunch. As a result, students talk more with each other." Question: Wetin happen because of di new rule?

1988.translation: As a result mean 'because of that'. E dey join cause and result.

1990.translation: Wetin follow As a result na di result.

1991.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Mina joined the school choir last month. She practices every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival. Mina is excited but also a little nervous." Question: When Mina join di choir?

1992.translation: Find di sentence wey get joined .

1993.translation: joined the school choir last month.

1994.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Many students use their phones during class. This makes it hard to listen to the teacher. Some schools now ask students to keep their phones in a box until lunch. As a result, students talk more with each other." Question: Wetin be di main idea for di passage?

1995.translation: Choose di main point of di whole passage, no be small detail.

1997.translation: Di passage talk say di phone rule help students focus and talk more.

1998.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Mina joined the school choir last month. She practices every Tuesday and Thursday after school. Next week, the choir will sing at the city festival. Mina is excited but also a little nervous." Question: How Mina feel?

1999.translation: excited but also a little nervous.

2000.translation: Read di passage and decide whether di sentence correct. "Many students use their phones during class. This makes it hard to listen to the teacher. Some schools now ask students to keep their phones in a box until lunch. As a result, students talk more with each other." Sentence: Some schools keep students' phones in a box until lunch.

2002.translation: E get di same meaning as keep their phones in a box until lunch .

2003.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Many students use their phones during class. This makes it hard to listen to the teacher. Some schools now ask students to keep their phones in a box until lunch. As a result, students talk more with each other." Question: Why e hard to listen to teacher?

2004.translation: Find wetin This for This makes it hard dey refer to for di sentence before am.

2005.translation: Di sentence before talk say: students use their phones during class.

2006.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.

2007.translation: For condition wey fit happen: If + present, will + base verb. For situation wey no agree with present fact: If + past (be become were), would + base verb.

2008.translation: Rain fit really fall tomorrow. Na condition wey fit happen.

2010.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If I ____ rich, I would buy a big house.

2011.translation: would dey later, so e dey imagine situation wey no agree with present fact.

2012.translation: For second conditional, di be verb na were .

2013.translation: For conditional if clause, use present tense even when na future.

2014.translation: Find di sentence wey use will for di if clause.

2015.translation: If I see him, I will tell him. correct.

2016.translation: Choose di words wey fit di blank for di conversation. A: I'm so tired every morning. B: If you ____ to bed earlier, you wouldn't feel so tired.

2017.translation: wouldn't dey later, so di if clause dey use past form.

2018.translation: If + past form (went), would + base verb.

2019.translation: Read di passage and answer. "Tom doesn't have a car, so he takes the bus every day." Question: Which sentence get di same meaning?

2020.translation: If you imagine di opposite of di fact (no car), di result too go opposite (no bus).

2021.translation: 'E no get car, na im make e dey enter bus' = 'If e get car, e no go dey enter bus.'

2022.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If it is sunny tomorrow, we ____ a picnic.

2023.translation: Na future condition wey fit happen.

2025.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If I ____ a bird, I would fly to you.

2026.translation: E dey imagine situation wey no agree with present fact.

2027.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If you heat ice, it ____.

2030.translation: Di grammar for this sentence correct? If I was you, I would study harder.

2031.translation: For second conditional, use were even when di subject na I .

2033.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: If she ____ more time, she would travel around the world.

2034.translation: would dey, so di if clause dey use past form.

2036.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: Look at the ____ baby.

2037.translation: Present participle (-ing) mean 'dey do' or 'dey cause feeling'; past participle (-ed) mean 'dem do am to' or 'dey feel something'. Dem dey describe nouns or feelings.

2039.translation: E mean say di action dey go on, so use di present participle sleeping.

2040.translation: Choose di word wey fit di blank: This is a book ____ in 1990.

2042.translation: E get passive meaning, so use di past participle written.

2043.translation: Use -ing for wetin cause di feeling, and -ed for di person wey feel am.

2044.translation: Check di part about di feeling wey 'I' get.

2045.translation: Na I feel di boredom, so I felt bored correct.

2046.translation: Choose di words wey fit di blank for di conversation. A: Why are you smiling? B: I was so ____ when I heard the good news.

2047.translation: Na B feel di excitement after e hear di good news.

2048.translation: Na di person wey feel am, so excited.

2049.translation: Read di passage and answer. "The girl dancing on the stage is my cousin. The song played at the party was her favorite." Question: Which words show di particular girl wey be di speaker cousin?
